recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body group portrait of four men in 1960s mod attire, set against a high-key, textured white background with bold, distressed slab-serif typography at the top and small red identification labels near their feet.
coreVisualRelationships: Staggered horizontal arrangement of figures creating depth
Contrast between dark jackets and high-key blown-out background
Dominant red title anchoring the top right quadrant
Fine-grain halftone texture unifying the photographic and graphic elements
coreInvariants: Desaturated color palette with a single punchy red accent

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four full-length figures occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, varying in scale to suggest depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, red, distressed slab-serif title in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold red title, moves down through the central figures, and settles on the small red name labels at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the upper half, used for track listing and title placement.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low overall saturation with high value contrast; red is the only high-saturation element.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to primary red, blue-denim, and neutrals

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Title uses extra-bold, wide slab serifs with a distressed, stamped texture
Secondary text uses a clean, italicized sans-serif
Metadata uses a small, all-caps condensed sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title characters feature intentional ink-bleed and erosion effects
Small labels use a monospaced-style sans-serif for a utilitarian look
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display slab serif paired with light, italicized sans-serif for tracklists.
graphicDevices: Bordered logo box in bottom corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif structure of the main title
Appropriate for the mid-century secondary sans-serif text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body portrait of four men in 1960s mod clothing (jackets, jeans, sandals) against a blown-out white studio background. Apply a heavy CMYK halftone dot texture and desaturate the colors slightly.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, distressed red slab-serif title in the top right. Place small red sans-serif names near the feet of each figure. Add a tracklist in blue italicized sans-serif in the upper center.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone texture visible across the entire image?
Is the title a heavy, distressed red slab serif?
Are the figures' clothes consistent with 1960s mod fashion?
Is the background high-key and mostly white?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (e.g., orange instead of red)
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent halftone dot size
Ensure red text has a 'stamped' or 'printed' texture
Verify that the lighting on the figures is consistent with a studio setting
Confirm the small red labels are legible but unobtrusive
recipe.reuseFormula: 1960s Portrait + Halftone Texture + Heavy Slab Serif + High-Key Background
